extraction.Name: Jacob Schweigman
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, not at the time of delivery, but before it was sent to me by mail, I was at the agency and some one of the officials there, I do not know sure which one, offered me the patent and I would not take it, and then in about a week I received it by mail.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I sold it for $9000 in the form of 60 15 heifers valued at $60.00.
extraction.Fee Patent Date: approximately 12 years before March 25, 1929 (received by mail)
extraction.NOTES: Patent received by mail; allottee did not sign a receipt for it and did not apply for it; sold land for $9000 in the form of heifers valued at $60.00 each; allottee states he is satisfied with the sale; has seven children, all of whom depend on him; document signed by Jacob Schweigman; notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on March 25, 1929.
